accepted_risks.risk: Vendor-site scraping reliability remains unproven across representative websites.
accepted_risks.acceptance_reason: User approved Stage 2 decision brief to proceed to architecture with carried risks.
accepted_risks.mitigation: Stage 3 designs bounded, observable, retryable scraping jobs; Stage 6 runs representative vendor-site tests.
accepted_risks.revisit_trigger: Before implementation validation of website import or if representative vendor-site tests fail.

accepted_risks.risk: Multi-tenant isolation and AI credential isolation are security-critical.
accepted_risks.acceptance_reason: User approved Stage 2 decision brief to proceed to architecture with carried risks.
accepted_risks.mitigation: Stage 3 defines tenant boundaries and credential handling; Stage 6 includes security tests.
accepted_risks.revisit_trigger: Before Stage 3 architecture approval and before Stage 6 implementation validation.

accepted_risks.risk: Willingness to pay is not directly validated.
accepted_risks.acceptance_reason: User approved Stage 2 decision brief to proceed to architecture with carried risks.
accepted_risks.mitigation: Run customer interviews and pricing tests before launch; keep Stage 3 architecture modular enough to adjust scope.
accepted_risks.revisit_trigger: Before launch readiness or when pricing/business model is finalized.

accepted_risks.risk: Users cannot understand long-running import progress
accepted_risks.acceptance_reason: User approved the Stage 4 UX/UI direction and accepted documented UX risks with mitigation paths.
accepted_risks.mitigation: Persistent job detail, step timeline, event log, retry/cancel, and partial-result access
accepted_risks.revisit_trigger: Before Stage 6 implementation validation or if the mapped UX mitigation cannot be implemented.

accepted_risks.risk: AI extraction creates unsafe or duplicate catalog records
accepted_risks.acceptance_reason: User approved the Stage 4 UX/UI direction and accepted documented UX risks with mitigation paths.
accepted_risks.mitigation: Discovery Session review gate, deterministic validation, explicit conflict states, no direct AI catalog writes
accepted_risks.revisit_trigger: Before Stage 6 implementation validation or if the mapped UX mitigation cannot be implemented.
